title: Duolingo Wrong
blurb: A small sound carrying an unreasonable weight of disappointment, largely because you know the owl saw it happen. Duolingo's incorrect buzz is the exact counterweight to its reward chime, and the contrast between the two turned a language app into a behavioural experiment with a mascot. The bird has since become the internet's most feared authority figure, complete with threatening notifications and a whole genre of jokes about surveillance. Play it when somebody gets something confidently, expansively wrong, ideally in front of witnesses. No hearts remaining.
